CSmplCharge::Init (debug string): voice note-on. Loads bank volume (prm 0x35+pad/16)x100 into voice[0x2b], sets up the envelope, the VARI stretch window (word 10 bits 1-2: 600/400/800) and the pitch ratio from words 13/14

Envelope breakpoints from attack/hold/release (words 22/23/24): attack and release = value*144000/127 frames (127 = 3 s at 48 kHz); hold end = start + len*hold/100; release ends at the hold end; if they overlap they meet at len*A/(A+R)
Release on note-off: release frames = R*144000/127, counted in 64-frame blocks (0x1fc0 = 127*64); no fade when shorter than 8128 frames (R < 7.2); capped at what's left of the sample
